{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sentient Property Crime Bureau''' was a special division of the police force on [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]]. The task of the organization was that of stopping the theft and resale of "personality-bearing artifacts", also known as [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
